segments.an5.100:1.1: Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosambiyaṃ viharati ghositārāme.[cūḷava.333,341] Tena kho pana samayena kakudho nāma koliyaputto [koḷīyaputto (sī. syā. ka.)] āyasmato mahāmoggallānassa upaṭṭhāko adhunākālaṅkato aññataraṃ manomayaṃ kāyaṃ upapanno.
segments.an5.100:1.4: Tassa evarūpo attabhāvapaṭilābho hoti – seyyathāpi nāma dve vā tīṇi vā māgadhakāni [māgadhikāni (sī. pī. ka.)] gāmakkhettāni.
segments.an5.100:1.5: So tena attabhāvapaṭilābhena neva attānaṃ [nevattānaṃ byābādheti (sī.)] no paraṃ byābādheti.
segments.an5.100:2.1: Atha kho kakudho devaputto yenāyasmā mahāmoggallāno tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ mahāmoggallānaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. Ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho kakudho devaputto āyasmantaṃ mahāmoggallānaṃ etadavoca –
segments.an5.100:2.4: Sahacittuppādā ca, bhante, devadatto tassā iddhiyā parihīno”ti.
segments.an5.100:2.6: Idaṃ vatvā āyasmantaṃ mahāmoggallānaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatthevantaradhāyi.
segments.an5.100:3.1: Atha kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.an5.100:4.1: “Kakudho nāma, bhante, koliyaputto mamaṃ upaṭṭhāko adhunākālaṅkato aññataraṃ manomayaṃ kāyaṃ upapanno hoti.
segments.an5.100:4.2: Tassa evarūpo attabhāvapaṭilābho – seyyathāpi nāma dve vā tīṇi vā māgadhakāni gāmakkhettāni.
segments.an5.100:4.3: So tena attabhāvapaṭilābhena neva attānaṃ no paraṃ byābādheti.
segments.an5.100:4.4: Atha kho, bhante, kakudho devaputto yenāhaṃ tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. Ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho, bhante, kakudho devaputto maṃ etadavoca –
segments.an5.100:4.5: ‘devadattassa, bhante, evarūpaṃ icchāgataṃ uppajji – ahaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ pariharissāmīti.
segments.an5.100:4.7: Sahacittuppādā ca, bhante, devadatto tassā iddhiyā parihīno’ti.
segments.an5.100:4.9: Idaṃ vatvā maṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatthevantaradhāyī”ti.
segments.an5.100:5.1: “Kiṃ pana te, moggallāna, kakudho devaputto cetasā ceto paricca vidito –
segments.an5.100:5.2: ‘yaṃ kiñci kakudho devaputto bhāsati sabbaṃ taṃ tatheva hoti, no aññathā’”ti?
segments.an5.100:5.3: “Cetasā ceto paricca vidito me, bhante, kakudho devaputto –
segments.an5.100:5.4: ‘yaṃ kiñci kakudho devaputto bhāsati sabbaṃ taṃ tatheva hoti, no aññathā’”ti.
segments.an5.100:5.5: “Rakkhassetaṃ, moggallāna, vācaṃ!(Rakkhassetaṃ, moggallāna, vācaṃ)[() sī. syā. kaṃ. pī. potthakesu natthi cūḷava.333 pana sabbatthapi dissatiyeva]!
segments.an5.100:5.7: Idāni so moghapuriso attanāva attānaṃ pātukarissati.
segments.an5.100:6.3: Idha, moggallāna, ekacco satthā aparisuddhasīlo samāno ‘parisuddhasīlomhī’ti paṭijānāti ‘parisuddhaṃ me sīlaṃ pariyodātaṃ asaṃkiliṭṭhan’ti.
segments.an5.100:6.5: ‘ayaṃ kho bhavaṃ satthā aparisuddhasīlo samāno parisuddhasīlomhī’ti paṭijānāti ‘parisuddhaṃ me sīlaṃ pariyodātaṃ asaṃkiliṭṭhan’ti.
segments.an5.100:6.6: Mayañceva kho pana gihīnaṃ āroceyyāma, nāssassa manāpaṃ.
segments.an5.100:6.7: Yaṃ kho panassa amanāpaṃ, kathaṃ naṃ [kathaṃ nu taṃ (sī.), kathaṃ nu (syā. kaṃ. pī. ka.), kathaṃ taṃ (katthaci)] mayaṃ tena samudācareyyāma –
segments.an5.100:6.9: yaṃ tumo karissati tumova tena paññāyissatī’ti.
segments.an5.100:6.10: Evarūpaṃ kho, moggallāna, satthāraṃ sāvakā sīlato rakkhanti;
segments.an5.100:6.11: evarūpo ca pana satthā sāvakehi sīlato rakkhaṃ paccāsīsati [paccāsiṃsati (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)].
segments.an5.100:7.1: “Puna caparaṃ, moggallāna, idhekacco satthā aparisuddhājīvo samāno ‘parisuddhājīvomhī’ti paṭijānāti ‘parisuddho me ājīvo pariyodāto asaṃkiliṭṭho’ti.
segments.an5.100:7.3: ‘ayaṃ kho bhavaṃ satthā aparisuddhājīvo samāno parisuddhājīvomhī’ti paṭijānāti ‘parisuddho me ājīvo pariyodāto asaṃkiliṭṭho’ti.
segments.an5.100:7.4: Mayañceva kho pana gihīnaṃ āroceyyāma, nāssassa manāpaṃ.
segments.an5.100:7.5: Yaṃ kho panassa amanāpaṃ, kathaṃ naṃ mayaṃ tena samudācareyyāma –
segments.an5.100:7.7: yaṃ tumo karissati tumova tena paññāyissatī’ti.
segments.an5.100:7.8: Evarūpaṃ kho, moggallāna, satthāraṃ sāvakā ājīvato rakkhanti;
segments.an5.100:7.9: evarūpo ca pana satthā sāvakehi ājīvato rakkhaṃ paccāsīsati.
segments.an5.100:8.1: “Puna caparaṃ, moggallāna, idhekacco satthā aparisuddhadhammadesano samāno ‘parisuddhadhammadesanomhī’ti paṭijānāti ‘parisuddhā me dhammadesanā pariyodātā asaṃkiliṭṭhā’ti.
segments.an5.100:8.3: ‘ayaṃ kho bhavaṃ satthā aparisuddhadhammadesano samāno parisuddhadhammadesanomhī’ti paṭijānāti ‘parisuddhā me dhammadesanā pariyodātā asaṃkiliṭṭhā’ti.
segments.an5.100:8.4: Mayañceva kho pana gihīnaṃ āroceyyāma, nāssassa manāpaṃ.
segments.an5.100:8.5: Yaṃ kho panassa amanāpaṃ, kathaṃ naṃ mayaṃ tena samudācareyyāma –
segments.an5.100:8.7: yaṃ tumo karissati tumova tena paññāyissatī’ti.
segments.an5.100:8.8: Evarūpaṃ kho, moggallāna, satthāraṃ sāvakā dhammadesanato rakkhanti;
segments.an5.100:8.9: evarūpo ca pana satthā sāvakehi dhammadesanato rakkhaṃ paccāsīsati.
segments.an5.100:9.1: “Puna caparaṃ, moggallāna, idhekacco satthā aparisuddhaveyyākaraṇo samāno ‘parisuddhaveyyākaraṇomhī’ti paṭijānāti ‘parisuddhaṃ me veyyākaraṇaṃ pariyodātaṃ asaṃkiliṭṭhan’ti.
segments.an5.100:9.3: ‘ayaṃ kho bhavaṃ satthā aparisuddhaveyyākaraṇo samāno parisuddhaveyyākaraṇomhī’ti paṭijānāti ‘parisuddhaṃ me veyyākaraṇaṃ pariyodātaṃ asaṃkiliṭṭhan’ti.
segments.an5.100:9.4: Mayañceva kho pana gihīnaṃ āroceyyāma, nāssassa manāpaṃ.
segments.an5.100:9.5: Yaṃ kho panassa amanāpaṃ, kathaṃ naṃ mayaṃ tena samudācareyyāma –
segments.an5.100:9.7: yaṃ tumo karissati tumova tena paññāyissatī’ti.
segments.an5.100:9.8: Evarūpaṃ kho, moggallāna, satthāraṃ sāvakā veyyākaraṇato rakkhanti;
segments.an5.100:9.9: evarūpo ca pana satthā sāvakehi veyyākaraṇato rakkhaṃ paccāsīsati.
segments.an5.100:10.1: “Puna caparaṃ, moggallāna, idhekacco satthā aparisuddhañāṇadassano samāno ‘parisuddhañāṇadassanomhī’ti paṭijānāti ‘parisuddhaṃ me ñāṇadassanaṃ pariyodātaṃ asaṃkiliṭṭhan’ti.
segments.an5.100:10.3: ‘ayaṃ kho bhavaṃ satthā aparisuddhañāṇadassano samāno parisuddhañāṇadassanomhī’ti paṭijānāti ‘parisuddhaṃ me ñāṇadassanaṃ pariyodātaṃ asaṃkiliṭṭhan’ti.
segments.an5.100:10.4: Mayañceva kho pana gihīnaṃ āroceyyāma, nāssassa manāpaṃ.
segments.an5.100:10.5: Yaṃ kho panassa amanāpaṃ, kathaṃ naṃ mayaṃ tena samudācareyyāma –
segments.an5.100:10.7: yaṃ tumo karissati tumova tena paññāyissatī’ti.
segments.an5.100:10.8: Evarūpaṃ kho, moggallāna, satthāraṃ sāvakā ñāṇadassanato rakkhanti;
segments.an5.100:10.9: evarūpo ca pana satthā sāvakehi ñāṇadassanato rakkhaṃ paccāsīsati.
segments.an5.100:10.10: Ime kho, moggallāna, pañca satthāro santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
segments.an5.100:11.1: “Ahaṃ kho pana, moggallāna, parisuddhasīlo samāno ‘parisuddhasīlomhī’ti paṭijānāmi ‘parisuddhaṃ me sīlaṃ pariyodātaṃ asaṃkiliṭṭhan’ti.
segments.an5.100:11.2: Na ca maṃ sāvakā sīlato rakkhanti, na cāhaṃ sāvakehi sīlato rakkhaṃ paccāsīsāmi.
segments.an5.100:11.3: Parisuddhājīvo samāno ‘parisuddhājīvomhī’ti paṭijānāmi ‘parisuddho me ājīvo pariyodāto asaṃkiliṭṭho’ti.
segments.an5.100:11.4: Na ca maṃ sāvakā ājīvato rakkhanti, na cāhaṃ sāvakehi ājīvato rakkhaṃ paccāsīsāmi.
segments.an5.100:11.5: Parisuddhadhammadesano samāno ‘parisuddhadhammadesanomhī’ti paṭijānāmi ‘parisuddhā me dhammadesanā pariyodātā asaṃkiliṭṭhā’ti.
segments.an5.100:11.6: Na ca maṃ sāvakā dhammadesanato rakkhanti, na cāhaṃ sāvakehi dhammadesanato rakkhaṃ paccāsīsāmi.
segments.an5.100:11.7: Parisuddhaveyyākaraṇo samāno ‘parisuddhaveyyākaraṇomhī’ti paṭijānāmi ‘parisuddhaṃ me veyyākaraṇaṃ pariyodātaṃ asaṃkiliṭṭhan’ti.
segments.an5.100:11.8: Na ca maṃ sāvakā veyyākaraṇato rakkhanti, na cāhaṃ sāvakehi veyyākaraṇato rakkhaṃ paccāsīsāmi.
segments.an5.100:11.9: Parisuddhañāṇadassano samāno ‘parisuddhañāṇadassanomhī’ti paṭijānāmi ‘parisuddhaṃ me ñāṇadassanaṃ pariyodātaṃ asaṃkiliṭṭhan’ti.
segments.an5.100:11.10: Na ca maṃ sāvakā ñāṇadassanato rakkhanti, na cāhaṃ sāvakehi ñāṇadassanato rakkhaṃ paccāsīsāmī”ti.
segments.an5.100:12.3: Sutaṃ kathā āraññako, sīho ca kakudho dasāti.

lines: Dve vā tīṇi vā māgadhakāni gāmakkhettānīti ettha māgadhikaṃ gāmakkhettaṃ atthi khuddakaṃ, atthi majjhimaṃ, atthi mahantaṃ.

Khuddakaṃ gāmakkhettaṃ ito cattālīsaṃ usabhāni, ito cattālīsanti gāvutaṃ hoti, majjhimaṃ ito gāvutaṃ, ito gāvutanti aḍḍhayojanaṃ hoti, mahantaṃ ito diyaḍḍhagāvutaṃ, ito diyaḍḍhagāvutanti tigāvutaṃ hoti.
Tesu khuddakena gāmakkhettena tīṇi, khuddakena ca majjhimena ca dve gāmakkhettāni tassa attabhāvo.
Yaṃ tumo karissati tumova tena paññāyissatīti yaṃ esa karissati, esova tena kammena pākaṭo bhavissati.

lines: 91-100. Pañcamassa paṭhame dutiye ca natthi vattabbaṃ.
Tatiye ājānanato aññā, uparimaggapaññā heṭṭhimamaggena ñātapariññāya eva jānanato.
Tassā pana phalabhāvato maggaphalapaññā taṃsahagatā sammāsaṅkappādayo ca idha “aññā”ti vuttā.
Adhigatamānenāti appatte pattasaññī, anadhigate adhigatasaññī hutvā adhigataṃ mayāti mānena.
